description: Noise classification gold standard for classify_text() (lemmas) and classify_phrase() (term clusters).
notes: EntityClass values: WORD_HE, WORD_LATIN, MIXED_ALPHA_NUM, NUMBER, QUANTITY_UNIT, MATH_EXPR, SYMBOL, PUNCT, OTHER. is_noise=true for: PUNCT, SYMBOL, NUMBER, QUANTITY_UNIT, MATH_EXPR, MIXED_ALPHA_NUM, OTHER, and for tokens too short or with high non-letter ratio.

classify_text_cases.description: Pure Hebrew word — valid, not noise

classify_text_cases.notes: All chars are non-letter, so NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH fires before any PUNCT-specific reason
Digits are non-letter chars, ratio=1.0 → NOISE_RATIO_NON_LETTER_HIGH

classify_text_cases.description: Pure Latin word — valid, not noise

classify_text_cases.notes: © is 1 char — NOISE_TOO_SHORT fires before NOISE_SYMBOL_ONLY

classify_text_cases.description: Single character Hebrew letter — classified as WORD_HE, not noise
classify_text_cases.notes: Classifier does not apply min-length noise rule to single Hebrew chars by default

classify_text_cases.description: Hebrew word with leading/trailing punctuation — noise

classify_phrase_cases.description: Phrase where majority tokens are noise — phrase is noise
classify_phrase_cases.notes: 3 tokens, all noise → ≥50% noise → phrase is noise

classify_phrase_cases.description: Mixed phrase — 1 noise token out of 3 — not necessarily noise
classify_phrase_cases.notes: 1/3 tokens are noise (the number 5) — less than 50% → phrase not noise

conservative.description: Only obvious structural noise: PUNCT, SYMBOL, single-char, math

balanced.description: Standard product profile — all auto-classified noise reasons

aggressive.description: Maximum cleanup — also marks very short words and high-ratio non-letter
